newsitem.title: USA: Motorola raises equity stake in Omniview.
newsitem.headline: Motorola raises equity stake in Omniview.

text.p: Motorola Inc said Tuesday its Multimedia Group has increased its equity stake in Omniview Inc, which has developed a patented photography technology.
Motorola officials were not immediately available to provide details of the transaction or the size of the increased stake.

Omniview's patented photography system allows customers to photograph and record places and events with standard cameras, then transform their photos and videos into 360-degree environments, Motorola said.

With software driven by a mouse click or keyboard stroke, Omniview's system enables people to move within an environment just as they would walk through it -- looking in any direction, even up and down, the company said.

Motorola made its initial investment in Tennessee based-Omniview in 1994. "With our first investment in Omniview, we recognized the company to have great potential," said John Battin, a Motorola senior vice president, in a statement.

In a related action, Motorola said James Phillips, a corporate vice president and general manager of Motorola's Multimedia Markets Division, will be leaving direct employment at Motorola to become chairman and chief executive officer of Omniview.
Omniview was an original member of Motorola's CyberSeed Venture program which invests in developing technology firms.
